RRVUNL Technician, Operator, Plant Attendant Final Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd (RRVUNL) has released the mains Result for the post of Technician-III (ITI)/ Operator-III (ITI)/ Plant Attendant-III (ITI). This recruitment was released for 2163 posts. Applications for the RRVUNL Various Post Recruitment 2025 were accepted from September 10, 2025, to September 25, 2025. The mains examination was conducted on February 23, 2026. Candidates who have appeared in this Examination can download their RRVUNL Technician, Operator, Plant Attendant Final Result 2026 from the link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 21 February 2025
  • Application Start Date : 21 February 2025
  • Last Date : 20 March 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 March 2025
  • Form Re Open
  • Application Start Date : 10 September 2025
  • Last Date : 25 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 24-27 November 2025
  • Admit Card : 14 November 2025
  • Pre Result (Group-II, Group-IV) : 09 January 2026
  • Pre Exam Result (Group-III) : 13 January 2026
  • Pre Exam Result (Group-I) : 16 January 2026
  • Pre Exam Result (Group-II) : 22 January 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 23 February 2026
  • Mains Result : 21 March 2026
  • Final Result : 22 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, EBC, MBC, BC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
